scope: Explicit bounded immutable Blob capability, actual bytes in replicated command transactions, committed-image reads, complete exact-cut archive dependencies and capture reservations. Component progress only; alarm/outbox scheduling is unimplemented.
environment: macOS native Rust Node/SDK/SQLite/LTX/Raft Engine/TLS. Blob native cases use one explicitly selected development voter and a conditional in-memory object store with dependency PUT faults; five new cases comprise three public Node cases and two private metadata/capacity cases. Owning regressions retain actual multi-node fixtures. No cellar_internal_tests.
limitations: Component qualification only. All 354 unique Rust cases across 16 binaries and all 31 checks pass on this source. Five new cases cover actual immutable bytes and digest/length validation, duplicate/empty values, capacity refusal, private rollback, explicit capability/host preflight before catalog creation, blocked dependency uploads with no S3 success, exact-ID strengthening without callback replay, recovery after deleting every node-owned file, and refusal of a missing selected dependency. An admitted S3 wait can return ArchiveUnavailable or Ambiguous for the exact original command; neither is success or rollback proof. The old archive head remains below the new Quorum cut until the dependency is durable. Archive capture reserves its full allowance before body allocation and includes dependency/membership memory before selecting entry clones. Class bounds enter the schema identity; classes without this opt-in retain their identity. Values remain retained with no GC API and are duplicated in SQL and dependency objects. This is not an external-reference-only or general Fleet Blob bucket adapter. Regressions include all88 Node,42 snapshot,29 archive,27 host,25 membership,18 reads,16 directory,50 Raft library,7 pure leadership, and all14 Fleet storage/replication/log-protocol cases. Ignored child entry points run through owning parents and are excluded. Numeric markers remain1. Only blob_archive_dependency of the six original MR-12 requirements is implemented; MR-12 remains IN_PROGRESS. Alarm/outbox intent dispatch, no-traffic timer recovery, receiver receipts, failover races, full unsupported mutable binding gates and their examples remain required. MR-13 through MR-17 remain open, including unified Node semantic Raft drain,24-hour soak,actual physical scale tiers and federation. No physical S3,power-loss,real failure-zone,production capacity or complete release is claimed. Existing vendored warnings remain visible.
